scope: Bounded discovery of official Swiss federal legislation and guidance on free movement, third-country family reunification, visas and mission procedure, administration and remedies, courts, public access, privacy, oversight, and family-status evidence. Selected cantonal and Turkish-mission examples are leads, not complete coverage.
retrieval_status: 26 configured texts/pages converted (including one externally extracted PDF); 1 retrieval/conversion error; 1 publication/discovery shell contained no extractable text; no source accepted

comparison_seed.jurisdiction: Denmark and the prior EEA/EU country reviews
comparison_seed.source: National free-movement residence rules, authority guidance, forms, remedies, and court sources
comparison_seed.relationship_note: Swiss AFMP/EFTA treaty rules are a close functional match for EU/EEA free-movement sources, not legally equivalent. Family members of Swiss citizens residing in Switzerland may follow the distinct FNIA route. A Swiss citizen relying on AFMP after residence in an EU/EFTA state is a separate fact-specific branch. Switzerland is an EFTA and Schengen participant, but not an EEA Contracting Party.

previous_findings_carried_forward: Use N-Lex, other-country registers, and prior discovery findings only as leads; verify each source at its responsible Swiss publisher.
Keep EU/EFTA family routes, the AFMP/EFTA Convention, family members of Swiss nationals under FNIA, UK acquired-rights cases, and ordinary third-country routes separate.
Keep publication authenticity, consolidated text, amendment/version discovery, authority guidance, mission instructions, and cantonal practice as separate source classes.

API documentation, ELI identifiers, open-data descriptions, and freely downloadable files do not prove live access, current-version selection, permitted reuse of every content class, or faithful conversion.
Switzerland has federal and cantonal authorities; a central SEM page or one canton does not establish coverage of all 26 cantons or all Swiss missions.

search_coverage.source_class: Federal publication, current legal text, versioning, and reuse
search_coverage.search_outcome: Candidate(s) found: Fedlex publishes federal legislation, versioned records, PDFs and machine-readable/open-data metadata. The official reuse page says Official Compilation PDFs are authoritative and exploitation is subject to Publication Ordinance Article 49. The main interface is JavaScript dependent in the research client.
query_terms: Fedlex API third-party users SPARQL XML
Fedlex legal information authoritative PDF Article 49 PublO
search_coverage.coverage_limit: No live Fedlex file or SPARQL query was fetched; the current amendment dates, exact text URLs, response formats, rate limits, registration requirements, and Article 49 reuse conditions for bulk automation remain to be verified. French and Italian version completeness was not exhaustively searched.

search_coverage.source_class: Residence and family-reunification law and guidance
search_coverage.search_outcome: Candidate(s) found: FNIA/OASA, AFMP/EFTA sources, current SEM family-reunification instructions, SEM AFMP guidance, and cantonal-authority directory. Official sources distinguish third-country family members of Swiss nationals from EU/EFTA family members. The signed 2026 Swiss–EU AFMP protocol is a pending legislative change lead.
query_terms: family reunification EU EFTA Switzerland SEM
AFMP free movement persons family reunification Switzerland 2026 protocol
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Central federal guidance was reviewed, but full Canton-specific rules, forms, decision practice, EFTA/Swiss edge cases, and the domestic status/commencement of every Bilaterals III measure remain open. Italian searches were not systematic.

search_coverage.source_class: Visa, consular filing, and mission practice
search_coverage.search_outcome: Candidate(s) found: SEM nationality-dependent visa guidance and appeal instructions; FDFA country and mission pages; Swiss Consulate Istanbul national-visa and family-document examples.

Switzerland visa refusal appeal 30 days SEM
entry visa requirements nationality Switzerland family EU EFTA
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Only the Istanbul representation was checked as a country-specific example. Mission-specific appointment providers, document checklists, fees, eligibility, and URLs can change; no other post was inventoried.

search_coverage.source_class: Administrative procedure, access, privacy, remedies, and oversight
search_coverage.search_outcome: Candidate(s) found: federal APA, federal court statutes, FoIA/FoIO, FADP/FDPIC channels, and the FOJ's notice that no federal Ombudsman office was created. The FOJ notice lists some cantonal/municipal ombuds offices but dates from 2004.
query_terms: Swiss FDPIC complaint FOIA mediation 20 days
Ombudsstelle des Bundes Kantone Federal Office Justice
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Federal procedure does not replace cantonal procedures for cantonal permit decisions. Ombuds coverage, cantonal data-protection authorities, and cantonal remedies require current canton-by-canton verification.

search_coverage.search_outcome: Candidate(s) found: Federal Administrative Court and Federal Supreme Court judgment databases; FOJ guidance for marriages abroad and registration through Swiss representations.
query_terms: Federal Administrative Court judgments database Switzerland
Bundesgericht all judgments database immigration family reunification
search_coverage.coverage_limit: The FAC says its database contains published judgments and its publication practice is selective for procedural decisions; the Federal Supreme Court says most decisions since 2000 and all final decisions since 2007 are available, generally anonymised. These are not complete records of all lower-court, cantonal, or unpublished decisions.
